meaning: A mistake in software that makes it behave in a wrong or unexpected way.
ex: QA found a bug in the checkout page this morning.

meaning: Instructions written in a programming language that a computer can run.
ex: Please push your code before the end of the day.

meaning: To check that software works correctly by running it or using checks.
ex: Can you test the login flow on Safari as well?

meaning: A computer or program that provides data or services to other computers.
ex: The server restarted twice last night.

meaning: An organized collection of data stored so it can be easily searched and updated.
ex: All user profiles are stored in the database.

meaning: To change something so that it is newer or more correct.
ex: Remember to update the README after you change the config.

meaning: To put software on a computer so it is ready to use.
ex: You need to install Node 20 to run this project.

meaning: A problem that stops a program from working correctly, often shown as a message.
ex: I keep getting a 500 error when I call that service.

meaning: A copy of data kept so it can be restored if the original is lost.
ex: We take a full backup of the database every night.

meaning: A particular release of software that is slightly different from earlier ones.
ex: Which version of Java are you running locally?

meaning: To repair a problem or bug so the software works correctly again.
ex: I'll fix the null check and push again in ten minutes.

meaning: Space or a system used for keeping data or files.
vi: lưu trữ, bộ nhớ lưu trữ
ex: Uploaded images go to cloud storage, not the app server.

meaning: To release software to an environment where it can be used.
ex: We deploy to production every Friday afternoon.

meaning: A piece of functionality in a product that users can use.
ex: The export feature is almost done, just missing tests.

meaning: A version of software that is made available to users.
ex: This fix will go out in the next release.

meaning: A separate line of development in version control where changes are made independently.
ex: Create a new branch from develop for this ticket.

meaning: To combine changes from one branch into another.
ex: Don't merge it until you get two approvals.

meaning: To save a set of changes to a version control repository.
ex: Please commit small changes with clear messages.

meaning: A place where code and its change history are stored and managed.
ex: The mobile app lives in a separate repository.

meaning: To find and remove errors in a program.
ex: I spent all afternoon trying to debug this timeout issue.

meaning: To suddenly stop working because of an error.
ex: The app starts to crash when the list has more than 1,000 items.

meaning: A setup of servers and settings where software runs, such as dev, test or production.
ex: The bug only shows up in the UAT environment.

meaning: A reusable structure of code that gives a base for building applications.
ex: We picked a framework that the whole team already knows.

meaning: A collection of ready-made code that developers can use in their programs.
ex: Is there a library for parsing dates, or should we write our own?

meaning: Something that a system must do or a condition it must meet.
ex: This requirement isn't clear, so let's ask the BA before we start.

meaning: To set up software or hardware with particular settings.
ex: You need to configure the proxy before you can pull images.

meaning: A record of events and messages produced by a running program.
ex: Check the log for any stack traces around 3 a.m.

meaning: The server side of an application that handles data and business logic.
ex: The backend returns the wrong status code for this case.

meaning: The part of an application that users see and interact with.
ex: The frontend still shows the old price after the update.

meaning: A short, fixed period in which a team completes a planned amount of work.
ex: We can't fit this story into the current sprint.

meaning: A prioritized list of work that still needs to be done.
vi: danh sách công việc tồn đọng, backlog
ex: Let's put it in the backlog and discuss it at planning.

meaning: A record in a tracking tool that describes a task, bug or request.
ex: Can you create a ticket for that and assign it to me?

meaning: To read and check someone's work, especially code, to find problems.
ex: Could you review my changes before lunch?

meaning: Written information explaining how software works or how to use it.
ex: The API documentation is out of date again.

meaning: To move to a newer or better version of software or hardware.
ex: We need to upgrade Spring Boot before support ends.

meaning: A temporary store of data kept so it can be accessed faster later.
ex: Try clearing the cache and reloading the page.

meaning: A request for data from a database.
ex: This query takes eight seconds on the reports page.

meaning: A database structure that makes searching for rows faster.
ex: Adding an index on user_id fixed the slow search.

meaning: Able to be used again in different places without rewriting it.
ex: Let's make this date picker a reusable component.

meaning: An unplanned event that disrupts or reduces the quality of a service.
ex: We had a P1 incident with payments last night.

meaning: A period when a system is not available or not working.
ex: The migration should run with zero downtime.

meaning: The live environment where real users use the system.
ex: Never test new scripts directly in production.

meaning: To watch a system over time to check its health and performance.
ex: Let's monitor the error rate for an hour after the release.

meaning: An automatic warning sent when something goes wrong in a system.
ex: I got an alert that disk usage is above 90%.

meaning: Software that acts like a separate computer running on a physical machine.
ex: Spin up a virtual machine with 8 GB of RAM for the load test.

meaning: An automated test that checks one small piece of code in isolation.
vi: kiểm thử đơn vị, unit test
ex: Please add a unit test for the discount calculation.

meaning: To make a bug happen again in order to study and fix it.
ex: I can't reproduce the issue on my machine.

meaning: A short daily team meeting where people share progress and problems.
vi: họp đứng hằng ngày, daily standup
ex: Let's take this offline after the standup.

meaning: A problem that stops someone from continuing their work.
ex: My only blocker is access to the staging database.

meaning: To decide which tasks are most important and do them first.
ex: We should prioritize the security fixes over new UI work.

meaning: To write the code that makes a design or idea actually work.
ex: Who wants to implement the retry logic?

meaning: A request to review and merge your code changes into another branch.
vi: yêu cầu hợp nhất mã, pull request
ex: I opened a pull request, so feel free to leave comments.

meaning: A small change to software that fixes a problem or security issue.
ex: The vendor released a patch for the vulnerability yesterday.

meaning: A limit on how long a system waits for a response before giving up.
ex: We increased the timeout to 30 seconds for the report API.

meaning: To deliver a finished feature or product to users.
vi: phát hành, đưa ra thị trường
ex: We want to ship dark mode by the end of the month.

meaning: A set of rules that lets different programs communicate with each other.
vi: giao diện lập trình ứng dụng, API
ex: The partner team exposes a REST API for order status.

meaning: To move data or systems from one platform or version to another.
ex: Next quarter we plan to migrate the old services to Kubernetes.

meaning: To improve the structure of code without changing what it does.
ex: Let's refactor this class before adding more logic to it.

meaning: An external library or service that your code needs in order to work.
vi: thư viện phụ thuộc, sự phụ thuộc
ex: This dependency hasn't been maintained for three years.

meaning: Able to handle more users or data without major changes.
ex: The current design isn't scalable beyond a few thousand users.

meaning: The delay between a request and its response.
ex: Users are complaining about high latency on the search endpoint.

meaning: The part of a system that slows down the whole process.
ex: The database is the bottleneck, not the application servers.

meaning: A bug where something that used to work stops working after a change.
ex: This looks like a regression from last week's refactoring.

meaning: A weakness in a system that attackers could use.
ex: The scanner reported a critical vulnerability in our logging library.

meaning: The process of checking who a user or system really is.
ex: We use OAuth for authentication on all internal tools.

meaning: The process of deciding what a user is allowed to do.
ex: The bug is in authorization: normal users can see admin pages.

meaning: Changing data into a secret code so only authorized people can read it.
ex: All personal data must use encryption at rest.

meaning: A specific URL where an API can be accessed.
ex: The new endpoint returns paginated results.

meaning: The practice of automatically building, testing and deploying code changes.
vi: tích hợp và triển khai liên tục, CI/CD
ex: Our CI/CD setup runs all tests on every push.

meaning: A series of automated steps that build, test and deploy code.
ex: The pipeline is red because the lint step failed.

meaning: A packaged unit that holds an application and everything it needs to run.
ex: Each service runs in its own container.

meaning: A group of connected servers that work together as one system.
ex: We added two more nodes to the cluster last week.

meaning: A system that spreads incoming traffic across several servers.
ex: The load balancer marked one instance as unhealthy.

meaning: The structure that defines how data is organized in a database or message.
vi: lược đồ, cấu trúc dữ liệu
ex: Changing the schema requires a migration script.

meaning: To return a system to a previous working version after a bad change.
ex: If error rates go up, we roll back immediately.

meaning: An urgent fix released quickly to solve a serious problem in production.
ex: We need a hotfix for the payment bug tonight.

meaning: A temporary way to avoid a problem without actually fixing it.
ex: There's a workaround for now, but we still need a proper fix.

meaning: An unusual situation that happens only at extreme or rare conditions.
ex: Did you handle the edge case where the list is empty?

meaning: Future extra work caused by choosing a quick solution instead of a better one.
ex: We should reserve some time each sprint to pay down tech debt.

meaning: Old but still in use, often hard to change or maintain.
ex: Nobody wants to touch the legacy billing module.

meaning: Easy to understand, change and fix over time.
ex: Clean naming keeps the code maintainable for new joiners.

meaning: A bug where a program keeps using memory and never releases it.
ex: A memory leak is causing the pods to restart every few hours.

meaning: A period when a service is completely unavailable.
ex: The outage lasted 40 minutes and affected all regions.

meaning: The main underlying reason why a problem happened.
ex: We restarted the service, but we still don't know the root cause.

meaning: A limit or level at which something, such as an alert, is triggered.
ex: Let's lower the CPU threshold for the alert to 80%.

meaning: To increase or decrease system resources to match demand.
ex: The service can scale out automatically during peak hours.

meaning: The servers, networks and tools that software runs on.
ex: We manage all our infrastructure with Terraform.

meaning: A test environment that closely copies production, used before release.
vi: môi trường thử nghiệm trước khi phát hành, staging
ex: It works on staging, so let's schedule the release.

meaning: The gradual release of a new feature or version to users.
ex: The rollout will start with 5% of users.

meaning: A setting that turns a feature on or off without deploying new code.
ex: Put the new checkout behind a feature flag.

meaning: Connecting different systems or components so they work together.
ex: The Slack integration sends a message when a build fails.

meaning: The percentage of code that is run by automated tests.
ex: Test coverage dropped below 80% after this merge.

meaning: To replace a real component with a fake one during testing.
ex: Just mock the payment service in your unit tests.

meaning: A meeting at the end of a sprint to discuss what went well and what to improve.
ex: Let's raise the flaky tests issue in the retrospective.

meaning: The conditions a user story must meet to be considered done.
ex: The acceptance criteria don't mention mobile, so should we support it?

meaning: To connect a system or component so it works with others.
ex: We still need to integrate the new SDK with our analytics.

meaning: To make code or a system run faster or use fewer resources.
ex: Before we optimize anything, let's profile it.

meaning: To check that data or input is correct and acceptable.
vi: kiểm tra tính hợp lệ, xác thực
ex: Always validate user input on the server side too.

meaning: To convert source code into a form a computer can run.
ex: The project doesn't compile after the last merge.

meaning: A small, independent service that does one job within a larger system.
ex: Each microservice owns its own database.

meaning: A list of function calls showing where an error happened in the code.
ex: Can you send me the full stack trace, not just the first line?

meaning: A change that makes existing code or clients stop working.
vi: thay đổi phá vỡ tương thích
ex: Renaming that field is a breaking change for the mobile app.

meaning: The time during which a system is running and available.
vi: thời gian hoạt động liên tục
ex: Our SLA promises 99.9% uptime.

meaning: The amount of data that can be sent over a network in a given time.
ex: Video uploads are using most of our bandwidth.

meaning: The amount of work or data a system processes in a given time.
ex: After the change, throughput went up to 5,000 requests per second.

meaning: Still available but no longer recommended and likely to be removed later.
vi: không còn được khuyến dùng, lỗi thời
ex: That method is deprecated, so use the async version instead.

meaning: Strong and able to handle errors or unexpected input without failing.
ex: We need a more robust retry mechanism for flaky networks.

meaning: Not needed because it repeats something else; or duplicated as a backup.
ex: This check is redundant because the validator already does it.

meaning: Running independently without waiting for other tasks to finish.
ex: Email sending should be asynchronous so the request returns fast.

meaning: The ability of a system to handle several tasks at the same time.
ex: This bug only happens under high concurrency.

meaning: A bug where the result depends on the timing of tasks running at the same time.
ex: There's a race condition when two users book the same seat.

meaning: A review after an incident to understand what happened and prevent it again.
vi: báo cáo phân tích sau sự cố
ex: I'll write the postmortem for yesterday's outage.

meaning: To set up and prepare servers or resources so they are ready to use.
ex: The script will provision a new database for each test run.

meaning: A statement in a test that checks whether a result is what you expect.
ex: This test has no assertion, so it always passes.

meaning: To analyze text or data and convert it into a structured format.
ex: We parse the CSV file and save each row to the database.

meaning: To replace default behavior or settings with your own.
ex: You can override the default timeout with an environment variable.

meaning: Hiding complex details behind a simpler interface.
ex: This abstraction makes it easy to switch storage providers.

meaning: Made of separate parts that can be developed and replaced independently.
ex: A modular design lets each team work on its own part.

meaning: To reduce how much two parts of a system depend on each other.
ex: A message queue helps decouple the order and email services.

meaning: A large application built as one single unit.
ex: We're slowly breaking the monolith into smaller services.

meaning: The actual data sent in a request or message.
ex: The webhook payload is missing the customer ID.

meaning: To clean input data by removing anything harmful or unsafe.
vi: làm sạch dữ liệu đầu vào
ex: Make sure you sanitize the HTML before rendering it.

meaning: To limit how often requests or actions are allowed.
ex: The provider will throttle us if we send more than 100 calls a minute.

meaning: Standard repeated code that must be written with little change.
ex: This generator removes a lot of boilerplate from our controllers.

meaning: Sometimes passing and sometimes failing without any code change.
ex: That test is flaky, so just re-run the pipeline.

meaning: Giving the same result no matter how many times an operation is repeated.
ex: The payment endpoint must be idempotent in case clients retry.

meaning: To convert an object into a format like JSON so it can be stored or sent.
ex: We serialize the event to JSON before publishing it.

meaning: Very detailed or divided into small, precise parts.
ex: We need more granular permissions than just admin and user.

meaning: Automatic coordination and management of many services or containers.
ex: Kubernetes handles container orchestration for us.

meaning: Still working with older versions of a system or its clients.
ex: The new API version must stay backward compatible for six months.

meaning: Present but hidden and not yet causing visible problems.
ex: The load test exposed a latent bug in the connection pool.

meaning: Always producing the same output for the same input.
vi: tất định, có tính xác định
ex: Tests should be deterministic, so don't depend on the current time.

meaning: The sequence of steps a team follows to complete work.
ex: Our Git workflow requires a review before anything reaches main.

meaning: Servers and services accessed over the internet instead of on local machines.
ex: We moved all our servers to the cloud last year.

meaning: A group of database operations that either all succeed or all fail.
ex: Wrap both inserts in a single transaction.
